sentences.text: Palaeacanthaspis vasta is an extinct acanthothoracid placoderm, a member of the class Placodermi known for their bony armor.
The genus was first described by Brotzen in 1934, and the species Palaeacanthaspis vasta remains the only known member of this group.
This animal belongs to the family Palaeacanthaspidae.
It lived during the early Devonian period in Europe.
